summary: Example group_vars/nxos.yml for CLI with network_cli, cisco.nxos.nxos, vaulted passwords, become enable and proxy command (paramiko variable deprecated in favour of libssh).
questions: What group_vars do I need for NX-OS over CLI?

answer_card.title: NX-OS CLI group_vars example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
ansible_connection: ansible.netcommon.network_cli
ansible_network_os: cisco.nxos.nxos
ansible_user: myuser
ansible_password: !vault...
ansible_become: true
ansible_become_method: enable
ansible_become_password: !vault...
ansible_paramiko_proxy_command: '-o ProxyCommand="ssh -W %h:%p -q bastion01"'
```
Use `ansible_libssh_proxy_command` instead of the deprecated paramiko variable. Drop the password with SSH keys and the proxy for direct access.
